scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @raftlabs/web" "npm run dev -w @raftlabs/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @raftlabs/shared && npm run build -w @raftlabs/api && npm run build -w @raftlabs/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @raftlabs/api && npm run test -w @raftlabs/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @raftlabs/shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
